notes.title: Major Changes and New Platform
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone! 👋[/h3][p][/p][p]This update is a bit delayed because I was preparing a version for [b]itch.io[/b]. Now you can play the demo [b]Knight's Errand[/b] right in your browser or on your phone. I hope this attracts more players, and the variety of opponents will become even greater. In addition, we have made many changes to the game and fixed a lot of bugs.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b] ⚔️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]💰 Updated Economy:[/b] Now the gold for lost squads and for defeated enemies depends on the course of the battle. This makes early defeats less painful, and late ones more tense, as compensation for losses decreases, and the reward for victory grows.[/p][p][b]📈 Reward for Defeats:[/b] If the player suffers a series of defeats, the reward for defeated enemies increases slightly for them to avoid a "death spiral". I'm not sure yet how balanced this is, so the mechanic may change in the future.[/p][p][b]🪙 Store Scaling:[/b] The number of units available for purchase now grows with the number of battles. This allows creating armies from cheap creatures even in late stages, adding variety to tactics and making the store fairer.[/p][p][b]🔄 Full Cost Refund:[/b] When disbanding a squad in the store, its full cost is now returned.[/p][p][b]🏆 Shared Leaderboard:[/b] [b]Play-off[/b] now uses a single leaderboard for all platforms — [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Itch.io[/b]. Opponent armies are also stored in a common repository.[/p][p][b]📊 Access to Rating:[/b] Now the game has a [b]full leaderboard[/b], not just the player's personal rank.[/p][p][b]🤖 Offline Mode:[/b] Even without an internet connection, battles continue, but against a doppelganger army.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Screen Resolution[/b] 🖥️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]📐 Scale Change:[/b] The game's resolution has been changed from [b]480x270[/b] to [b]630x460[/b]. On large monitors, the game now looks much better, and it gives me more flexibility to work with the interface. On mobile devices, the game seems a bit small now, but I plan to add mode switching in the future.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Interface[/b] ⚙️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🎮 New Main Menu:[/b] The game now has a main menu with buttons for feedback and adding to the wishlist.[/p][p][b]⛓️ Animated Menus:[/b] All main menus are now hung on chains and appear and disappear effectively. I hope fans of old strategies will like this.[/p][p][b]💨 Separate Initiative:[/b] The [b]initiative[/b] indicator is now displayed separately from the number of units, allowing for a quicker assessment of the battlefield situation.[/p][p][b]➡️ Disappearing Indicator:[/b] After a squad's turn, its initiative disappears to not take up space on the screen.[/p][p][b]💡 Highlighting Information:[/b] Panels with the number of units and initiative now come to the foreground when hovering over a unit, allowing quick assessment of its stats without obscuring the rest of the screen.[/p][p][b]✨ Button Highlighting:[/b] In the store, when the player has no squads in the army, not only units are highlighted, but also buttons for their purchase. This will help newcomers better understand the interface.[/p][p][b]🖱️ Improved Controls:[/b] Combinations [b]Shift+LMB[/b], [b]Ctrl+LMB[/b] and double-click now deselect the original squad after splitting it. From a [b]UI/UX[/b] perspective, this is more logical.[/p][p][b]🪙 Slider Limitation:[/b] The unit quantity slider in the store now moves only up to the maximum available for purchase, making the process more convenient if gold is insufficient.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bugs[/b] 🐞[/h3][p][/p][p][b]✅ Correct Damage:[/b] Potential damage for blocked ranged units is now calculated correctly.[/p][p][b]🗑️ Disappeared Copies:[/b] Dragging a squad in the store no longer leaves a copy with 0 units.[/p][p][b]🎶 Looped Sounds:[/b] All background sound effects are now looped and do not stop after the first playback.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Total Battle Background Overhaul
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]I'm excited to introduce the new development diaries. This update focuses on visuals and artificial intelligence.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/bb51cbd00763272c65530efa8d56480d5dc17b99.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Updated Battle Backgrounds 🏞️[/h2][p]The [b]battle scene backgrounds[/b] have been completely revamped. They are now much more detailed, varied, and vibrant. Four new backgrounds are available so far, with more to come in future patches. Existing ones will also keep improving. Each background now comes with matching [b]sound design[/b], further immersing you in the battle atmosphere. [b]🔊[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/11777a49dfc93c6da7257f9dfd5fe66a9f93d322.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]AI Improvements 🧠[/h2][p]Two small changes have significantly enhanced the enemy AI:[/p][list][*][p][b]♟️Strategic Planning[/b]: The enemy now plans moves ahead, selecting optimal tiles to attack your units on the next turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎯Target Selection Optimization[/b]: The AI now chooses attack targets more effectively, especially when the damage exceeds the target’s health.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Other Changes ✨[/h2][list][*][p][b]🏆Clearer Game Objective[/b]: The game now more clearly highlights the goal of achieving [b]ten victories[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]🖥️Improved Interface[/b]: The active skills and defense panel in battles has been reduced in size to avoid overlapping with unit stats on the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📝Post-Game Survey[/b]: After exiting the game, a page with a [b]short survey[/b] about your demo experience will open. Please take a moment to share your thoughts—it’ll help make the demo even better![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]In Conclusion[/h2][p]While these patch notes may not seem as massive as previous ones, a lot of important work has been done. I hope you enjoy the game’s new look as much as I do! You can check out all the changes right now by downloading the demo via the link. Share your feedback on the patch, take part in the survey, and, of course, [b]add the game to your wishlist! ⭐[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Huge Battle UI Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]Pleased to present a demo update that brings significant improvements to the gameplay! The main changes involve the combat interface; additionally, there are refinements to the animation system, fund reimbursement, and AI behavior, along with several important bug fixes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/cf782e7b8cd5246cc538e48537fceafd2e2f4bf5.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Combat Interface Changes ⚔️[/h3][p]The combat interface is now significantly more [b]informative and user-friendly[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🗺️ [b]Movement Zone Display:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When hovering over an enemy unit, its [b]movement zone[/b] now appears.[/p][/*][*][p]🌐 Pressing the [b]ALT[/b] key shows the [b]movement zones of all enemies[/b], which helps better assess threats and plan actions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎯 [b]Damage Prediction:[/b] Now, the [b]potential damage[/b] to an enemy can be predicted in advance, allowing for more informed tactical decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]Attack Result:[/b] After an attack, the [b]amount of damage dealt and units destroyed[/b] are displayed above the target.[/p][/*][*][p]❤️ [b]Top Unit Health:[/b] The [b]current health indicator[/b] for the top unit in a stack has been added for a better understanding of the army's current state.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/5c58b6bb6501e85e5215631f742a0449b53f072d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]⏳ [b]Initiative Scale Position:[/b] To the right of the unit count in a stack, its [b]position on the initiative scale[/b] is now displayed, simplifying turn planning.[/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ [b]Detailed Unit Characteristics:[/b] In combat, a [b]right-click[/b] on a unit now shows [b]all its characteristics[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/c83000a28977c708697958eae4a54c97e768909e.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]💡 [b]Unit Selection Hint:[/b] A [b]hint about selecting a unit[/b] has been added when multiple units have the same initiative.[/p][/*][*][p]🔄 [b]Counterattack Indication:[/b] The display of counterattack availability has been reworked:[/p][list][*][p]🌟 If a unit has a counterattack, the [b]number of units in the stack is displayed in gold[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]⚪ If it has already used its counterattack, the number is [b]displayed in white[/b], allowing for instant assessment of the unit's readiness to retaliate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Other Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]🎬 [b]Animation System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]animation system has been completely reworked[/b]. While it might not be immediately noticeable, transitions between animations should be [b]smoother[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 This change forms the foundation for future improvements and will allow for [b]more flexible animation customization and synchronization with sounds[/b], which will make the game feel more alive and dynamic in the future.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]💰 [b]Fund Reimbursement System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]full fund reimbursement system[/b], regardless of the number of victories, has been reinstated. This seems to be the fairest approach for players at the moment.[/p][/*][*][p]🧹 Consequently, a [b]wipe of the army pool[/b] has been performed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]AI Improvements 🤖[/h3][p][/p][p]AI behavior has been slightly improved:[/p][list][*][p]🏹 [b]Ranged Unit Targeting:[/b] Ranged units controlled by AI now [b]consider the threat[/b] posed by the player's unit when determining targets for attack.[/p][/*][*][p]🛡️ [b]Melee Unit Defense:[/b] AI now [b]correctly defends its melee units[/b], making its tactics more coherent.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes 🐞[/h3][p][/p][p]Several bugs have been fixed:[/p][list][*][p]💎 [b]Incorrect Rarity Display:[/b] Fixed an issue with the [b]incorrect display of unlocked unit rarity[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 [b]Cursor Scale:[/b] The [b]cursor scale bug[/b] has been addressed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Hope these changes make your gaming experience even more enjoyable! I continue to work on improving the game and welcome your feedback! Try the new patch, share your thoughts on the demo in the comments, and add the full version of the game to your wishlists![/p]

notes.title: New Initiative and Rarity Systems
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
Meet the unscheduled update for the Knight's Errand demo version. Last week, I found out that players from China couldn’t access the server to upload their armies or download others’. So, this week, the game has been switched to a different backend. I hope this resolves all issues for everyone. However, if you enter a battle and there are no enemy units, please let me know!

[b]Other changes in this patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] The initiative system has been reworked. Units are now strictly divided by initiative level. This change aims to enhance the tactical aspect of unit selection during a player’s turn.
[*] Unit levels have been replaced with rarity. This change is intended to encourage players to think more about specific units as a whole, rather than just buying the highest-level ones.
[*] Alongside the introduction of rarity, the shop generation system has been revamped. The shop’s assortment should now be more diverse and fair. This isn’t the final version, and I’ll continue refining this aspect based on feedback.
[*] The internal unit naming system is now much more reliable. This ensures that players’ armies will be preserved between patches, regardless of changes to the project’s structure.
[*] All buttons with V and X icons have been replaced with context-appropriate words. This is meant to make the game interface more intuitive.
[/list]  
[b]AI behavior changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] AI units no longer stand still, even if they can’t find a direct path to their target.
[*] AI units use defense less often and move the maximum distance more frequently.
[/list]  
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The unit stats screen is now always centered on the screen.
[*] A player’s unit no longer skips its turn if there are no free cells around for movement.
[*] Ranged attacks now work correctly when the target is surrounded.
[/list]  
Add the game to your wishlists, try the demo, and share your thoughts in comments and reviews.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/
